name: Astral Upload (Psionic)
body:
Prerequisites(s): Astral Mechanics*, Technologist*, ability to manifest astral construct.

Benefit(s): When you manifest astral construct and create an astral robot, you may augment the power as follows:

Augment By spending 4 additional power points, you may upload an AI from a storage bay or other receptacle in your possession into the astral robot. The astral robot gains the aggregate template alongside all of the benefits of the AI that was uploaded into it. You cannot use this ability to upload an AI whose CR exceeds your manifester level. If the astral robot is destroyed, the AI returns to your storage bay.
